uv run --no-sync python -c 'import collections, hashlib, json, sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
sys.path.insert(0, "scripts")
from audit_irc_sources import load_math_author
from materialize_outcome_score_data import file_sha256, payload_sha256
root = Path.cwd()
packet_path = root / "artifacts/data/irc_v1_allocations/fit.json"
packet = json.loads(packet_path.read_text())
config = json.loads((root / "research/irc-real-runtime-config-v1.json").read_text())
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(root / "tmp/irc-qwen3-tokenizer-v1", local_files_only=True)
extract, equivalent = load_math_author(root)
rows = []
for row in packet["rows"]:
    messages = [{"role": "user", "content": config["instruction"] + row["problem"]}]
    prefix = tokenizer.apply_chat_template(messages, tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True, enable_thinking=True)
    answer = extract(row["solution"])
    assert answer is not None and answer.strip()
    completed = tokenizer.apply_chat_template(messages + [{"role": "assistant", "reasoning_content": row["solution"], "content": "\\boxed{" + answer + "}"}], tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=False, enable_thinking=True)
    prefix_ids = tokenizer.encode(prefix, add_special_tokens=False)
    full_ids = tokenizer.encode(completed, add_special_tokens=False)
    assert full_ids[:len(prefix_ids)] == prefix_ids
    assert completed[len(prefix):].splitlines()[0] == "<think>"
    assert equivalent(extract(completed), answer)
    rows.append({"cluster_id": row["cluster_id"], "subject": row["type"], "level": row["level"], "prompt_tokens": len(prefix_ids), "target_tokens": len(full_ids) - len(prefix_ids), "total_tokens": len(full_ids), "target_token_sha256": payload_sha256(full_ids[len(prefix_ids):])})
stats = {}
for field in ("prompt_tokens", "target_tokens", "total_tokens"):
    values = np.asarray([r[field] for r in rows])
    stats[field] = {"count": len(values), "sum": int(values.sum()), "mean": float(values.mean()), "minimum": int(values.min()), "p50": float(np.quantile(values,.5)), "p95": float(np.quantile(values,.95)), "p99": float(np.quantile(values,.99)), "maximum": int(values.max())}
print(json.dumps({"schema":"irc-fit-source-length-audit-v1","packet_sha256":file_sha256(packet_path),"tokenizer_files_sha256":{p.name:file_sha256(p) for p in (root/"tmp/irc-qwen3-tokenizer-v1").iterdir() if p.is_file()},"source_only":True,"model_completions_inspected":0,"questions":len(rows),"native_prefix_identity_passed":len(rows),"native_thinking_field_and_terminal_answer_passed":len(rows),"statistics":stats,"over_8192":[r["cluster_id"] for r in rows if r["total_tokens"]>8192],"subject_counts":dict(collections.Counter(r["subject"] for r in rows)),"level_counts":dict(collections.Counter(r["level"] for r in rows)),"lengths_content_sha256":payload_sha256(rows),"longest_rows":sorted(rows, key=lambda r:r["total_tokens"], reverse=True)[:8]}))'
